searchText: It was unsupported for a couple months after release simply because no one asked for it but Infura added it as soon as someone asked, yet somehow everyone keeps saying it’s not supported. IIRC it was mentioned in the Helios readme as unsupported which is where most people seem to have first encountered the RPC.
